subject: Evaluation MAP: Data retention carveouts & DPA signoff (Olive Bank)
messages:
From: Trevor Benson <trevor.benson@olivebank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: retention carveouts we need to confirm

Vanessa / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to formalize the mutual action plan (MAP) for Olive Bank's evaluation and eventual procurement. Before we schedule legal review, two items are blockers for us:

1) Data retention windows by data class (PII, transaction metadata, logs) and how Redwood can limit retention per customer/region.
2) DPA clauses for limited-purpose processing and subcontractor (in particular, any cloud providers or third-party telemetry vendors).

Can you share a simple retention matrix and confirm whether Redwood will accept carveouts for short-term replay logs (14 days) versus archival metadata (7 years) for regulatory compliance? Also, do you have a draft DPA we can start redlining?

Goal: align MAP milestones so our compliance team can clear the SOC 2 evidence intake and legal can start a narrow DPA redline. Ideally we close evaluation and DPA signoff within 3–4 weeks.

Thanks,
Trevor Benson
Director, Cloud Engineering
Olive Bank

Attachments: none
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Trevor Benson <trevor.benson@olivebank.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: retention carveouts we need to confirm

Trevor — thanks for the clear ask. High level answers, and then a proposed MAP with owners and dates below.

Retention / data classes (short):
- PII (customer/employee identifiers): default retention 30 days for request/response cache; archival metadata can be retained per customer policy — we support per-customer retention configuration and can enforce region-specific residency.
- Transaction metadata (non-sensitive): default 90 days; archival export possible upon request.
- Operational logs / replay traces: configurable; default 14 days, with optional 14/30/90 day settings for dedicated customers.

DPA / subcontractors:
- We will provide a draft DPA for initial redlines today (see attachment). Redwood uses cloud providers for compute/storage; subcontractors are listed in section 7 and we accept vendor notice and flow-down obligations typical for financial customers.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- 2027-03-16: Redwood sends retention matrix + draft DPA (owner: Vanessa)
- 2027-03-18: Olive Bank compliance to provide initial retention carveouts & must-have DPA edits (owner: Trevor)
- 2027-03-22: SOC 2 evidence intake call (owner: Marissa)
- 2027-03-26: Legal finalize DPA redlines; mutual e-sign target (owner: legal teams)
- 2027-03-31: Evaluation decision / commercial close target

We can compress or extend timelines depending on legal availability — happy to add a 30‑minute legal sync to keep things moving.

I attached a draft DPA and a starter retention matrix (CSV). If those look okay I’ll loop Marissa to schedule the SOC 2 evidence intake.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: draft_DPA_OliveBank_2027.docx; retention_matrix_olb.csv
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Trevor Benson <trevor.benson@olivebank.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: retention carveouts we need to confirm

Trevor / Vanessa — adding technical detail for the compliance checklist and evidence intake.

SOC 2 evidence we commonly provide on intake call:
- Infrastructure architecture diagram (redacted): shows VPC boundaries, subnets, and region failover.
- Access control matrix and IAM policies: who has token-level access and how secrets are rotated.
- Retention configuration docs: how per-customer retention is enforced (policy flags + TTL enforcement job).
- KV cache behavior & encryption-at-rest details.
- Subprocessor list (we provide full list in the DPA appendix).

Notes on data residency & retention enforcement:
- For Private/Dedicated customers we support region enforcement and can disable cross-region replication.
- Retention enforcement is implemented as a nightly TTL sweep plus explicit purge APIs for forced deletions; audit logs capture deletion events for 6 months by default, can be extended on contract.

Attached: redwood_soc2-evidence-index.xlsx (index of docs to pull) and a proposed retention matrix with fields you can edit.

On the DPA: our legal team prefers to keep subcontractor notice and list in an appendix rather than a contractual flow-down obligation for every small subprocessor; for major cloud providers we accept flow-down with the standard carveouts. We can mark the DPA to accept a 30-day notice period for new subcontractors for Olive Bank.

Let us know which specific data classes need strict residency beyond the defaults and we’ll mark those as MAP acceptance criteria.

—SoJin
Soojin Lee
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2-evidence-index.xlsx; retention_matrix_olb.csv
From: Trevor Benson <trevor.benson@olivebank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Olive Bank Legal <legal@olivebank.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: retention carveouts we need to confirm

Vanessa / Soojin — this is very helpful, thank you. A few clarifications from Legal & Compliance:

- Olive Bank will require explicit contractual language to ensure the nightly TTL purge cannot be disabled unilaterally without a documented change request and 30-day notice. Can Redwood accept that as an addendum?
- For PII retention: we need the default 30-day cache purge to be configurable to 14 days for our UAT and 30 days for production. Please confirm the configuration is per-environment and can be enforced from our side (we prefer a customer-managed toggle in Dedicated).
- DPA: our counsel will redline the draft and requests DocuSign for the final signoff. Please provide the DocuSign envelope when Legal is ready.

If Redwood can accept the purge addendum plus per-environment retention toggles, we can commit to the MAP dates you proposed. Let’s schedule the SOC 2 evidence call for 3/22 at 10am PT.

I’ll ask legal to send initial DPA comments by EOD 3/18.

Thanks — Trevor

-----Forwarded message from legal@olivebank.com-----

Expect a DocuSign request once redlines are addressed.

—Olive Bank Legal
